## Kinema 1.2

- **Intros and credits found for you.** Where your server doesn't know an episode's or film's intro and credits, Kinema now looks them up in **TheIntroDB** and **IntroDB**, free online databases of intro, recap and credit times kept by their users (by the title's TMDB, TVDB or IMDb id). The Skip Intro and Skip Credits buttons, automatic skipping and Up Next at the credits then work everywhere, also for downloads watched offline.
- **Switch it on and off where you are**: Settings → Playback → Skipping has **Find intros and credits online** next to the choices for intros, credits and recaps, and the player's ••• menu now has **Skip intros automatically**, **Skip credits automatically** and **Find intros and credits online**, and says where the times came from.
- What your server knows comes first, then the marks you set yourself, then the databases.
- **Quick Connect from Kinema.** Settings → Accounts has a **Quick Connect** button on the account you're using: type the code a TV, computer or another phone shows on its Quick Connect screen, and it's signed in as you.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later).
